title: Image Captions Schema v1.0
description: Per-figure structured descriptions for downstream agents that cannot view PNG images. Accepts both flat-object format (vlm-visual-analyzer) and wrapped-object format (generate_captions.mjs). Also accepts legacy array format for backward compatibility. Consumed by diagnostician, judge, and reporter.

anyOf.description: Flat format: {filename: figure_caption, ...} or wrapper format: {generated_at, figures: {filename: ...}}

figures.description: Wrapped format: all figure captions keyed by filename

anyOf.description: Legacy array format: [{figure, purpose, key_observations, diagnostic_implication}, ...]

purpose.description: What diagnostic question this figure answers

diagnostic_implication.description: ONE sentence: what this plot tells the Diagnostician about root cause

description.description: One paragraph: what this figure shows, how it was generated, what parameters are plotted

key_observations.description: 3-5 concrete bullets with ACTUAL NUMBERS — r values, p values, threshold values, anomaly counts, drift rates

diagnostic_implication.description: ONE sentence: what this plot tells the Diagnostician about root cause. Must be directly citable as evidence.

chart_type.description: overlay | scatter | heatmap | bar | line | profile | boxplot | diagram

validation_issues.description: Statistical validation issues: Simpson reversal, Pearson-Spearman divergence, trend confounding, outlier-driven

trend_shapes.description: Linear / accelerating / decelerating / flat / periodic / irregular / pulse_burst

anomaly_regions.description: Time windows or group labels where anomalies cluster

vlm_notes.description: Additional VLM insights — nuance, subtle patterns, reading confidence
